[EN] They're going to skin me alive if I go back without a good excuse, .

You know, cryptkeeper kulkaris have surrounded the Crypt of the Forsaken. If I said I was late because of them, and that you and I fought together to defeat them, no one would even bring up the "several days late" part.

And my story would be at least half-true, right?
[ES] Van a desollarme vivo si vuelvo sin una buena excusa, .

Sabes, los cryptkeeper kulkaris han rodeado la Crypt of the Forsaken. Si dijera que llegué tarde por su culpa, y que tú y yo luchamos juntos para derrotarlos, nadie sacaría a relucir la parte de "varios días tarde".

Y mi historia sería al menos medio verdad, ¿no?

[EN] Well, , you've spared me one of Galla's lectures about tardiness.

She can be very naggy sometimes.
[ES] Menos mal, , que me has librado de otra de las charlas de Galla sobre la puntualidad.

A veces puede ser muy pesada.

[EN] It's gonna take more ears than that to impress Galla.
[ES] Vas a necesitar más orejas que esas para impresionar a Galla.
